problem: The vector $v=⟨8,-14⟩$ is rotated $\frac{7\pi }{6}$ radians counterclockwise about the origin. Find the image of $v$ under this rotation.

examples.knowledge_point: Rotating a Vector About the Origin
examples.problem: The vector $\mathbf{v}=\langle -5,4 \rangle$ is rotated $135^{\circ}$ counterclockwise about the origin. Find the image of $\mathbf{v}$ under this rotation.
examples.worked_solution:
A rotation of $135^{\circ}$ counterclockwise about the origin is represented by the matrix 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14055662/assets/2dc8ed7a595473ee6a1fb498dc1c6605b5b5860aa15c6148a1d154f15d4a14c6.png)

To find the image $\mathbf{v}'$ under the action of the matrix $R_{135^{\circ}}$, we compute the matrix product, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}^{′} & ={R}_{{135}^{∘}}\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \\ -\frac{9}{\sqrt{2}}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the image is $\mathbf{v}'=\left\langle \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}, -\dfrac{9}{\sqrt{2}} \right\rangle.$
